meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Private Pool With Heating Options ($75/night Fee Applies)* Dog Park Nearby – Just 2 houses away* Pet-Friendly (Fees and Restrictions Apply; See Below)* Blue Mountain Beach Regional: 0.5 miles* Golf Cart (6-Seater LSV)
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Private Pool With Heating Options ($75/night Fee Applies)* Dog Park Nearby – Just 2 houses away* Pet-Friendly (Fees and Restrictions Apply; See Below)* Blue Mountain Beach Regional: 0.5 miles* Golf Cart (6-Seater LSV) Included At The Home* 4 Bikes Included* Multiple Private Balconies* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef- more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under 25. No Exceptions.* *We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November through February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest so we can further assist!Welcome to Crisp Ocean Breeze, a stunning 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath coastal retreat nestled in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach along iconic Scenic Highway 30A. Just moments from the sugar-white sands and emerald-green waters of the Gulf, this beautifully designed home offers the perfect combination of luxury, comfort, and relaxed coastal living. From the moment you arrive, you’ll feel right at home in the bright, inviting spaces thoughtfully designed for gathering, relaxing, and creating unforgettable vacation memories. The main level features a spacious open-concept living area with soaring ceilings and plenty of room for everyone to unwind after a day at the beach. The fully equipped kitchen makes preparing meals for the group a breeze, while the nearby dining area offers seating for six around a beautiful wood table accented by elegant chandelier lighting. Step outside and discover your own private backyard oasis, complete with a sparkling heated pool, covered lounge area with ceiling fans, shaded seating, and a dedicated grilling station—perfect for poolside afternoons, family cookouts, and relaxing evenings under the stars. The first-floor master suite provides a peaceful private retreat with the convenience of single-level living, while the second-floor master suite offers its own private balcony and outdoor living space, making it the perfect spot for morning coffee or winding down with a glass of wine after a day along 30A. An additional guest suite with a private ensuite bathroom provides comfort and privacy for family and friends. The third floor is sure to be a guest favorite, featuring a spacious bunk and entertainment room with custom-built bunks and plenty of room for kids, teens, and groups to hang out, enjoy movie nights, play games, or share late-night stories. Multiple private balconies throughout the home invite you to enjoy the gentle Gulf breezes and beautiful surroundings. For added convenience, the laundry room is located on the second floor and includes a full-size washer and dryer. With its spacious accommodations, multiple outdoor living areas, private heated pool, and prime Blue Mountain Beach location, Crisp Ocean Breeze is the perfect 30A getaway for families and groups looking to relax, reconnect, and make lasting beach vacation memories.The Bed Setup: 1st Floor:Master Bedroom 1: King Bed2nd Floor:Master Bedroom 2: King Bed + Twin Bed with Twin TrundleGuest Bedroom 1: 2 Queen Beds3rd Floor:Guest Bedroom 2: 2 Twin-over-Twin Bunk Bed + Twin Bed + Twin Trundle** Please note: Pet Fee is $250/pet and is nonrefundable. Please note that we can accept requests for 1 dog under 50 lbs. Pets are subject to approval.Crisp Ocean Breeze is located in the charming village of Blue Mountain Beach, tucked between Highway 30A and hundreds of acres of State Forest. Crisp Ocean Breeze is convenient to the beach, shopping, and other hotspots while still being quiet and secluded. You will love the dog park-just two houses down!- and taking a stroll to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for a delicious treat. This community is centrally located, making it easy to drive to many locations, including the neighboring communities of WaterColor and Seaside. Area Attractions: 30A is a fantastic destination; the beaches are some of the world’s best with sugar-white sand and emerald green waters. You will find plenty of beach access along a 17-mile stretch of Santa Rosa Beach. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes 30A famous. There are activities for everyone: kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is 12-19 feet deep. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
